arguments:
  vehicle: "The vehicle."

  park: "Where it is parked at the end, when that is not where it was driven to."
  fuel_pct: "How full the tank is after, in percent."
  miles: "Miles added to its odometer."
  hours: "Hours added to its engine hours."
  sums: "true to record also what the world's tables work out for the trip and the call left out (fuel burned, miles, hours), as filled in from the world."
  source: "Where it comes from: from is prose, lore, author, gm, character, player, default or invented; lore, message and roll cite an entry, a message or a roll by id; an invention cites its gap_check and consent."

  standing: "How it stands: established, proposed or assumed."

Records a vehicle driven, ridden, sailed or flown to a place: it stands where it was parked, and its driver and the riders named arrive with it. Only what the call gives is recorded: the fuel left, the miles or hours added; with sums, what the tables work out and the call left out is recorded too, as filled in. It passes no time. A trip the world's routes cannot make is recorded as the call gave it, and the answer says so. The answer says what changed and how the vehicle and its people now stand.
